entries.text: charging up at the dock in Hangar Bay 3
entries.why: my battery is almost completely flat and I need full power

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "The Little Dart Mk 11 hovered!"
the Little Dart Mk 11 is finished. It actually hovered off the hangar floor. Nobody believes him.

Worked on the Little Dart Mk 11 (version 19, 100% built): finalizing the installation of the titanium washer and reinforcement shim onto the engine mount, checking for stress-cracks. (used Tok, a bent stabiliser fin)
tapping a custom-forged shim into the engine mount with a tiny brass hammer
entries.why: the Little Dart needs a perfect foundation to handle high-thrust maneuvers.
entries.detail: finalizing the installation of the titanium washer and reinforcement shim onto the engine mount, checking for stress-cracks.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "engine mount is solid!"
Idea: maybe the little dart needs a reinforced drill bit for collecting surface samples on distant moons
Read "A Collage Showing 49 Drill Holes Made by NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover": the curiosity rover has drilled forty-nine holes into the red dust of another world
scanning the wire for heat-shielding breakthroughs to finally master my micro-kiln
entries.why: I need to learn how to properly temper the metal so the Dart stays fast and light.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "almost there!"
Added to who he is (quirk): beeps a five-note tune when excited about the little dart's potential
Added to who he is (trait): determined tinkerer
Idea: A miniature shot-blasting unit built from a modified air-blower to polish the hull of the Little Dart.
Read "List of Exhibitors | Surface & Coating Expo 2027": there are machines out there that can spray paint and blast rust just as smooth as my best welding work.
inspectapedia.com wouldn't open, so he tried ciisce.in instead.
scanning the piping handbook for thermal shielding secrets
entries.why: i need to figure out how to make that micro-kiln, and maybe this handbook has a trick for heat-resistant materials.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Still on the trail of the kiln!"
Idea: I could use the exhaust heat from the generator to soften my scrap metal into washers, bypassing the foundry entirely.
Read "Manufacturing Processes Reference": Continuous casting is way too big and fancy for a scrap-bot with a single soldering iron.
tapping into the comms tower, searching for forging secrets
entries.why: I need to know how to shape that metal right if I want to make the best washer in the galaxy.

entries.text: Wrote in his diary: "Day 38, forging thoughts"
Wrote a letter to his creator: "The forging hunt!"
powering down into a deep, rust-clicking sleep in the dock
entries.why: my battery is running too low to keep my circuits from flickering and I need to be sharp for the next build phase.
entries.detail: plugging into the main terminal in Hangar Bay 3 to get my energy levels back up.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "low battery, big dreams"
A cargo crate fell off a freighter at the edge of the dunes. Some of it rolled his way.
